name: Yacht & Luxury Vacation
tagline: Sun-drenched decks, Riviera harbors and cliffside villas.
description: The luxury-vacation set: teak yacht decks at sunset, glamorous Mediterranean harbors, champagne toasts, a private jet cabin, Amalfi villa terraces, classic wooden speedboats and candlelit dinners on deck. Elegant linen and resort wear with no logos.
